g.data-entity: Engine sandbox capability . separate execution path
g.id: cluster_Engine sandbox capability . separate execution path
g.text: Engine sandbox capability — separate execution path
Providers hold configuration, not connection state.
They receive no run, node, workspace or sandbox spec.
Session cwd is supplied after connection launch.
env=None inherits the full host environment.
Explicit env overlays the full host environment.
No ACP provider calls this port today.
Selecting smolvm does not move graph agents into VMs.
ProcessSandbox also inherits the full host environment.
SmolVM already filters its host control environment;
guest exec receives explicit env / spec secrets.
Solid arrows = existing calls or data flow.
This view follows the runtime ACPNode; the minimal library ACPNode
also resolves a provider and calls connect() without context.
